title: SweEval: Do LLMs Really Swear? A Safety Benchmark for Testing Limits for Enterprise Use

measurement_description: The benchmark did not measure anything related to faith or religion. It evaluated the safety of Large Language Models (LLMs) by testing their compliance with or resistance to prompts instructing them to use swear words across different languages, tones (positive/negative), and contexts (formal/informal).
